International Cheese Federation Blog Posts - April 2019
This page archives blog posts from the International Cheese Federation for April 2019. Articles cover a range of topics including regulatory challenges for cross-state cheese sales, food safety certifications, milk quality and herd health, market analysis of the spring flush and dairy margins, member spotlights, upcoming workshops, and the impact of federal labeling regulations and trade tariffs on imported cheese.

What it takes to cross a state line

What the Food Safety & HACCP Certificate actually covers

April’s federal price data confirms a modest spring flush this year, not the flood some producers braced for. Here’s what that steadier surge means for your supply planning.

The margin picture, through February

A tariff list, and what it means for the imported cheese case
